title: Thai Black Bean Fritters
description: Crisp Thai fritters made with black beans, perfect as a snack or side dish.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350F.
In a large bowl, mash the black beans using a fork until they're mostly smooth.
Add the hash brown, coconut flakes, oats, egg, green chilies, garlic, and fish sauce to the bowl with the mashed black beans.
Mix well until everything is fully incorporated.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties.
When the oil is hot, add 2-3 patties to the pan and fry for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until they're golden brown.
Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the fritters hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
Repeat the frying process with the remaining patties.
